name: What are the advantages of hiring an owner-operated contractor for a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of hiring an owner-operated contractor for a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Working with an owner-operated general contractor gives you a single point of contact who works directly on your job site every day. Abraham Becerra leads the framing, drywall, carpentry, tile, and painting work directly while coordinating licensed trades for electrical and plumbing. This setup eliminates communication gaps between off-site salespeople and job-site crews, keeps overhead costs reasonable, and allows for rapid adjustments if you decide to modify trim details, finish carpentry, or tile patterns during construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: You work directly with the hands-on project lead on site, ensuring clear communication, quality finish work, and direct oversight without multiple corporate management layers.
